description: Add description metadata to workflow profiles, create example profiles, add mo workflow list CLI, and update Web UI

tasks.title: Server: Add description field to WorkflowDefinition YAML schema and model
tasks.description: Add optional Description property to WorkflowDefinition record. Parse the top-level description key from workflow YAML block scalars in WorkflowYamlSerializer.FromYaml and emit it in ToYaml. Add a multi-line description block to mohist-default.workflow.yaml. Update MohistDefaultIssueWorkflowProfile.Description, SystemTemplates list, and SystemRoutes detail endpoint to source description from the parsed WorkflowDefinition rather than hardcoded strings. Handle missing description with fallback 'No description provided'.
acceptanceCriteria: mohist-default.workflow.yaml has a multi-line description field using YAML block scalar
WorkflowDefinition.Description returns the parsed multi-line text from YAML
WorkflowYamlSerializer round-trip (FromYaml → ToYaml → FromYaml) preserves description
SystemTemplateInfo gains IsDefault field; SystemTemplates list carries correct isDefault values
GET /api/workflow-templates/system returns description from YAML and isDefault boolean
GET /api/workflow-templates/system/mohist/default returns description from YAML
Profile YAML without description field uses fallback 'No description provided'
Workflow engine execution is unaffected by description field presence
tasks.output: WorkflowDefinition.Description populated from YAML; mohist-default.workflow.yaml updated; API responses carry multi-line description
tasks.notes: WorkflowYamlSerializer already uses IgnoreUnmatchedProperties() so existing YAML files without description won't break. Description is passive metadata — not consumed by the workflow engine.

tasks.title: Server: Create quick-fix and experiment workflow profiles
tasks.description: Create MohistQuickFixIssueWorkflowProfile and MohistExperimentIssueWorkflowProfile classes implementing IIssueWorkflowProfile. Both reuse MohistWorkflow.Definition for stages but have distinct Id, DisplayName, and multi-line Description. Register in IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry. Add entries to ProjectWorkflowProfileManager.SystemTemplates. Extend GetSystemTemplateDefinition to return MohistWorkflow.Definition for mohist/quick-fix and mohist/experiment. Add profile ID constants to IssueWorkflowProfiles.
acceptanceCriteria: mohist/quick-fix profile appears in system template list with distinct description indicating fast simple fixes
mohist/experiment profile appears in system template list with distinct description indicating exploration/prototyping
Both profiles reuse MohistWorkflow.Definition stages
IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry.List() returns all three profiles
GetSystemTemplateDefinition returns definition for all three profile IDs
All three profile descriptions are sufficiently distinct for AI semantic matching
tasks.output: Three distinct workflow profiles available: mohist/default, mohist/quick-fix, mohist/experiment
tasks.notes: New profiles are class-based with hardcoded metadata. They share MohistWorkflow.Definition for stages since the only difference is metadata. No separate YAML files needed.

tasks.title: CLI: Add mo workflow list command
tasks.description: Create the CLI workflow command group with a list subcommand. Implements mo workflow list calling GET /api/workflow-templates/system. Human-readable output shows display name (with default indicator) and description with preserved formatting. --json flag outputs valid JSON array suitable for agent skill consumption. Follows the existing thin-client pattern: no local YAML parsing or business logic. Handles server-not-running error with standard messaging. Uses the server-provided isDefault field rather than deriving it locally.
acceptanceCriteria: mo workflow --help shows list subcommand
mo workflow list displays all profiles with display name, description, and default indicator
Multi-line descriptions render with preserved formatting in human output
mo workflow list --json outputs valid JSON array with id, displayName, description, isDefault
JSON isDefault value matches server response (not derived by CLI)
JSON output is self-contained with no transient or environment data
Command shows standard 'Server is not running' error when server is down
CLI does not parse YAML or compute metadata locally
tasks.output: cli/commands/workflow.ts providing mo workflow list with human and --json output
tasks.notes: The API endpoint GET /api/workflow-templates/system already exists and returns profiles. The CLI simply formats the response. Follow the pattern from mo skills list.

tasks.title: Web UI: Render multi-line workflow profile descriptions prominently
tasks.description: Update WorkflowProfilesSection components to render full multi-line descriptions with preserved line breaks. In ProfileCard, use whitespace-pre-line to show full description text rather than single-line truncation. In ProfileDetail, move description to the top of the view (above stages and YAML) and render with readable formatting. Update the entities/settings frontend types if needed (WorkflowProfileInfo.description already exists as string). Ensure single-line descriptions still display without truncation issues.
acceptanceCriteria: ProfileCard in profile list renders multi-line description with preserved line breaks
ProfileDetail shows full description at top of view, above stages and YAML sections
Description uses readable proportional font (not monospaced) in detail view
Single-line descriptions still render without truncation or layout issues
YAML section remains accessible below description and stages
TypeScript types for WorkflowProfileInfo/WorkflowProfileDetail remain compatible
tasks.output: Updated WorkflowProfilesSection.tsx rendering multi-line descriptions prominently
tasks.notes: The backend API already returns multi-line description via SystemTemplateInfo. The frontend just needs CSS whitespace-pre-line and layout reordering. The frontend's getWorkflowProfiles() can use server-provided isDefault after T-001 adds it to SystemTemplateInfo.
